title: the Melnibonean mythos
audit_comment: THE MELNIBONEAN MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round fourteen, print pp. 86-95, the monster-heaviest round of the walk: fourteen of the thirty-three rows are monsters, from the Assassinator of the Gods to the Vulture Lion. The headline adjudication: the ELRIC DUAL PRINT - the emperor carries the walk's only dual armor class (6 and minus 6, the latter the Stormbringer wield-state) and a dual move (6 and 15); his printed Standard-or-85% magic resistance pins 0 with the 85 riding the Stormbringer consts. The SEE BELOW 99 PAIRS (the egp Isis precedent): Grome and Nuru-ah print See below on both the cleric and magic-user lines, Kakatal, Misha and Straasha on the magic-user/illusionist line - all pinned 99. The VARIABLE PINS: Arioch prints both SIZE: Variable and CHARISMA: Variable - both pinned 0 with col comments. The negative charisma cells: Nnuurrr and Pyaray print CH: -6. The flagged odd prints pinned as printed: the Haaashastaak and Nnuurrr W: 3 wisdom cells. The BARE AND STRAY SIZE PRINTS: Fileet the bare L pinned 0 (the R861 bare-M precedent), the Vampire Trees the L-plus-25-feet-tall print read as 300 with the stray plus noted. The XP romans of the monster rows verified: VIII/6,200 Assassinator flat, X/21,450 Quaolnargn flat, VIII/6,391 Mordagz flat, and the per-hit-point rows Clakar VI/650+10, Dharzi II/90+5, Myyrrhn III/125+4, Nihrain and Oonai VII/1,950+14, Mist Giant VIII/4,950+16, Vampire Trees VIII/3,850+16, Vulture Lion IX/5,600+20; the Kelmain Variable XP rides a bool. The fraction fingerprint: three X 1/2 cells - Moonglum 66, Theleb K'aarna 66, Yyrkoon 78. The ELENOIN-GRAHUK ENMITY PAIR: the hereditary enemy flags, the grk printed-rivalry precedent, the round's only rivalry print. The psionic pipes: the w10 single pipe I of Arioch, Darnizhaan, Meerclar and Nuru-ah, Pyaray II, the w49 VI of Grome, Haaashastaak, Misha, Roofdrak and Straasha.

banner.title: the Melnibonean mythos - the D&DG walk round fourteen, print pp. 86-95: thirty-three beings from Elric the albino emperor of Melnibone through Yyrkoon the evil cousin, the three greater gods (Arioch, Donblas, Xiombarg), the six lesser gods (Darnizhaan, Grome, Kakatal, Misha, Pyaray, Straasha), the six demigod master types of the demi-planes (Fileet, Haaashastaak, Meerclar, Nnuurrr, Nuru-ah, Roofdrak), the four heroes (Elric, Moonglum, Theleb K'aarna, Yyrkoon) and fourteen monsters across thirteen plane codes.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 087-096; the second printing) with the column-split tsv dumps; the collation voice: the archive.org 1st-print derivative (deities-demigods-1st-print) - the chocr char-level word geometry at 600dpi plus the djvu.xml word geometry. The adjudications: the Elric 6/minus 6 dual armor class and 6/15 dual move with the Standard-or-85 magic resistance pinned 0, the See below 99 pairs (Grome, Nuru-ah, Kakatal, Misha, Straasha), the Arioch Variable size and charisma pins 0, the Nnuurrr and Pyaray minus 6 charisma cells, the Haaashastaak and Nnuurrr wisdom 3 odd pins, the Fileet bare L and the Vampire Trees stray plus size prints, the fourteen monster XP roman decodes, the three fraction cells (Moonglum 66, Theleb 66, Yyrkoon 78) and the Elenoin-Grahuk enmity pair.
